_doc: Blind accuracy census (cycle 76): every pooled number independently re-extracted from committed source by an offline checker BLIND to the stored value; deterministic compare; disagreements hand-adjudicated against source. See scripts/error_rate_compare.py + error_rate_pass2.py.
measured_against: docs/error_rate_sample.json (the committed sample of every pooled number at measurement time)
confirmed_our_errors_note: 1 wrong number (semaglutide GI-AE wrong endpoint) surfaced AND fixed this cycle; the 3 remaining disagreements are checker-side (label wording / estimand choice).
not_recheckable_note: sourced from ClinicalTrials.gov results / full text, so not re-extractable from the abstract the checker was given (not evidence of error).

adjudication.note: Numbers identical (0.80 [0.60-1.06]); we label it IRR, the checker wrote "rate ratio" (RR). A rate ratio on TOTAL/recurrent HF hospitalizations IS an incidence-rate ratio; our IRR label is correct.

ROCKET-AF: checker took the on-treatment/per-protocol HR 0.79; its own note flags the ITT HR 0.88, which is what we store — consistent with the other all-ITT NOAC trials. Our ITT choice is the standard MA choice.
ASCEND: numbers identical (0.97 [0.87-1.08]); IRR vs "rate ratio" wording only. Our IRR label is correct.

fixed_this_cycle.note: Wrong endpoint: overall-AE counts (141/161 vs 61/81) were pooled under a gastrointestinal-AE outcome; the abstract has no GI-specific count. FIXED cycle 76 via an absent-override (declared absent). This is the one confirmed defect the census surfaced; it had passed every gate.
